projects.title: KOBANIQ
projects.subtitle: AI career intelligence for job seekers
projects.summary: KOBANIQ is an AI-powered career intelligence platform that helps job seekers in Somalia and Somaliland evaluate their skills, discover relevant job opportunities, prepare for interviews and build tailored CVs.
projects.appNote:
Open this link on your Android phone (or scan the QR code on the page with your phone camera).
Tap Install to download the KOBANIQ test app (APK).
Open the downloaded file. If Android asks, allow installing apps from this source.
Tap Install, then open KOBANIQ and create your profile.
projects.problem:
Job seekers in Somalia and Somaliland often struggle to identify jobs that genuinely match their skills, understand what different positions require, evaluate their actual technical abilities and prepare competitive CVs and interviews.

Existing job-search approaches offer little guidance on skill gaps, career readiness or personalised preparation, leaving job seekers unsure what to improve and how to approach the right opportunities.
projects.solution: KOBANIQ brings AI-powered skill assessment, job intelligence, personalised CV generation and interview preparation together in one mobile app. It verifies skills with adaptive quizzes, explains why each job matches a profile, highlights the skills that are missing, writes job-specific CVs only from the user's own profile and lets users practise interviews with feedback on every answer.
projects.features:
AI Skill Assessment: Adaptive quizzes check the skills users claim and return an assessed level with strengths, weaknesses and recommendations.
Job Intelligence: Researches jobs from configured sources and explains every match with a score and the skill gaps to close.
AI-Powered CV Builder: Generates job-specific CVs from the job description and the user's own profile, ready to export as a PDF.
Interview Preparation: Practise technical and behavioural interviews with AI-generated questions and feedback on each answer.
Career Insights: One place to see skills, assessments, progress and recommendations for improving career readiness.
Notifications: Relevant job alerts and application-related updates, delivered to the phone.

projects.subtitle: Water-utility billing and customer management
projects.problem:
A water utility has to keep track of many customers, their meters, monthly readings, bills and payments. When that information is spread across paper records and separate files, billing is slow, mistakes are easy to make and it is hard to see who has paid and who still owes.

Customers also have no simple way to check their own bills, see what is unpaid or look back at their payment history.
projects.solution:
Shaba Water Billing System brings everything into one connected platform. Administrators and managers use a web dashboard to manage customers, meters, billing, reports and manager accounts, while customers use a mobile app to sign in and see their bills, unpaid amounts, payments and payment history.

Both apps talk to the same Express REST API, which stores customers, managers, meters, bills and payments in MongoDB, so staff and customers always see the same up-to-date information.
projects.features:
Customer Mobile App: Customers sign in from their phone to see their bills, profile and account details in one place.
Bills & Unpaid Balances: Shows each customer's bills and highlights what is still unpaid.
Payments & History: Records payments and lets customers look back at their full payment history.
Admin Dashboard: A web dashboard for managing customers, meters and billing, with dashboard statistics and transactions.
Meters & Billing: Track meters and readings and turn them into bills for each customer.
Reports & Manager Accounts: Billing reports for the utility, plus separate administrator and manager accounts with token-based sign-in.
